archetypes.name: upgrade-flow
archetypes.rationale: The core behavior changes are in upgrade-larch same-version sparse-cone reconciliation and cache pruning semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the upgrade-larch runtime path for the SCRIPT_ROOT versus PLUGIN_ROOT split, already-latest idempotency, drift detection, reinstall flow, verification, and prune protection. Pay special attention to source-time behavior, HOME-dependent marketplace paths, and whether the machine-readable reconcile signal is emitted only after a verified same-version repair. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: release-state
archetypes.rationale: The release skill now coordinates working-tree upgrade invocation, root selection, captured output parsing, state persistence, and restart messaging.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the release Step 7 and Step 8 guidance as an operational workflow rather than ordinary prose. Check whether root-resolution ordering, output capture, fallback behavior, release-step7.env persistence, and restart decisions are sufficiently concrete and internally consistent for a real /release run. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: hook-failopen
archetypes.rationale: SessionStart now sources a new library and probes local marketplace git state inside a non-blocking hook surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the SessionStart sparse-cone drift probe for fail-open behavior under set -euo pipefail, stripped PATH, empty HOME, malformed or missing library state, and non-worktree cwd. Confirm it remains read-only, cwd-independent, and emits only fixed advisory content without leaking local paths or command output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-isolation
archetypes.rationale: The tests rely on sourcing runtime scripts under isolated HOME and reapplying mutable globals, which can create false confidence if fixtures are wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the upgraded shell harnesses for hermeticity and meaningful assertions around HOME isolation, repeated sourcing, LARCH_CACHE_DIR resets, fake marketplace clones, and release root-resolution mirrors. Look for tests that accidentally exercise the developer environment, compare a library against itself, miss stderr capture, or fail to model the production script behavior they claim to cover. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sparse-contract
archetypes.rationale: A new shared sparse allowlist library creates a cross-surface contract spanning runtime scripts, hooks, docs, lint excludes, and release instructions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new sparse allowlist contract as a shared architecture boundary across upgrade-larch, SessionStart, release guidance, docs, and lint configuration. Check for duplicated allowlist text that can drift, incorrect source-of-truth claims, missing edit-in-sync obligations, or consumers sourcing the allowlist from the wrong root. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
